key.name: terminal-columns
key.description: Default number of terminal columns (characters) for new windows. Set to 0 to use auto (derived from pixel/window geometry); set to -1 to ignore and leave the terminal/pty default.

key.name: terminal-rows
key.description: Default number of terminal rows (characters) for new windows. Set to 0 to use auto (derived from pixel/window geometry); set to -1 to ignore and leave the terminal/pty default.
